app.learningDashboard.help.title: Learning Dashboard Help
app.learningDashboard.help.activityScore: How The Activity Score is Computed

The user's activity score is calculated based on their participation in a session. The score is a sum of 5 normalized metrics, each contributing up to 2 points. Each metric is normalized so that the highest performer in each category gets the full 2 points, and others get proportionally less.
Moderators always receive a score of 0 and do not participate in the metrics computation.
